title: When the Oath Sings Again
author: Casper Voss
blurb: Juniper Hartwell, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
